title: Set Mismatch
goal: Identify the duplicated and missing values in the expected set 1 through n.
strategy: Count visits to each expected slot from 1 through n. A twice-visited slot and an unvisited slot identify the error.

phasePurposes.inspect: Count visits to each expected slot from 1 through n. A twice-visited slot and an unvisited slot identify the error.
phasePurposes.update: The duplicate uses a slot twice; the missing number never occupies its slot.
phasePurposes.done: The duplicate uses a slot twice; the missing number never occupies its slot.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
